analysis: The retrieved medical knowledge indicates that interferon beta (Beta IFN) is commonly used to treat relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis. While natalizumab is also effective for treating relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis, it is typically considered when other treatments have failed or in more severe cases. Therefore, based on standard treatment protocols, Beta IFN is the first-line therapy for relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis, making it the drug of choice in this context.
